what: Novartis develops and sells prescription medicines, with a focus on heart disease, immunology, neuroscience and cancer. After spinning off Sandoz and Alcon it is a pure innovative-drug company.
customers: Patients through hospitals, pharmacies, insurers and government health systems.
money: branded drugs such as Entresto, Cosentyx, Kesimpta and Kisqali
moat: Patent-protected drugs, a deep research pipeline and global sales reach.
risks: Drug-pricing pressure in the US and Europe
